top_signals.title: US seeks $61M in USDT allegedly tied to sanctioned Iranian oil sales
top_signals.summary: Tether froze $61.19 million across 10 Tron addresses in 2025 that prosecutors allege were connected to black-market Iranian oil proceeds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Gabon Bonds Surge After Government Audit Finds Lower Debt Stock
top_signals.summary: Gabon’s bonds surged after the government announced that an audit found the OPEC member’s debt stock stood at $16.7 billion, almost a fifth below an initial estimate.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Former Tokyo massage parlor operator given five years for employing Thai girl
top_signals.summary: Masayuki Hosono was found guilty of having the 12-year-old girl work at the parlor and having her perform sexual services.
